channel.title: Tuoi Tre News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Tuoi Tre News (tuoitrenews.vn)

item.title: Polish tourists join Vietnam’s Mekong Delta communities for hands-on Lunar New Year experience
item.description: More than 70 tourists from Poland joined local residents in Vietnam’s Mekong Delta in early February to experience traditional Lunar New Year (Tet) customs, as travel firms expand culture-focused tours for inbound visitors.

item.title: Vietnam's Fields Medalist Ngo Bao Chau to join University of Hong Kong
item.description: Vietnamese mathematician Ngo Bao Chau, the country’s only Fields Medal laureate, will officially join the University of Hong Kong (HKU) in June 2026 after 15 years at the University of Chicago in the U.S.

item.title: January sets record with nearly 2.5mn foreign visitors to Vietnam
item.description: Vietnam welcomed nearly 2.5 million international visitors in January 2026, the highest monthly total on record for the country’s tourism industry, official data showed.

item.title: India-US trade deal gives tariff-free access to Harley bikes, no reprieve for Tesla
item.description: NEW DELHI - India will slash tariffs on high-end American cars to 30% from as high as 110% and eliminate duties on Harley-Davidson bikes under an interim trade pact, an official said, but will not make concessions for electric vehicles, a move that pointedly leaves Tesla out.

item.title: Double-decker buses might be penalized for illegal stopping in downtown Ho Chi Minh City
item.description: The Ho Chi Minh City Road Traffic Infrastructure Management Center under the municipal Department of Construction has proposed strict penalties against open-top double-decker buses that illegally stop and park while picking up and dropping off passengers in downtown Ho Chi Minh City, citing repeated violations of traffic regulations and risks to public safety.

item.title: For some young Vietnamese, renting a holiday ‘partner’ eases Lunar New Year pressure
item.description: Lunar New Year is traditionally a time for family reunions in Vietnam, but for many young, unmarried adults it has also become a season of social pressure, as parents and relatives press them about relationships and marriage.

item.title: Police fire water cannon at protesters hurling smoke bombs in Olympic host Milan
item.description: MILAN - A group of around 100 protesters threw firecrackers, smoke bombs and bottles at police after breaking away from the main body of a demonstration in the Olympic host city of Milan on Saturday.

item.title: India's Modi visits Malaysia to boost trade, security ties
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR - India's Prime Minister Narendra Modi will meet his Malaysian counterpart Anwar Ibrahim on Sunday, as the two countries look to bolster trade and explore potential collaborations in semiconductors, defence and other fields.

item.title: Vietnam to survey English proficiency of teachers
item.description: The Ministry of Education and Training will roll out a nationwide plan to survey the English proficiency of teachers, but the survey results will be kept confidential.
